# `lobbying_affiliated_organizations`

**Affiliated organizations disclosed on lobbying filings**

The affiliated organizations an LDA filing discloses: organizations other than the client that contribute to the lobbying activities and actively participate in planning, supervising or controlling them. Each row is the organization as stated on this filing. Keyed `(filing_uuid, affiliated_organization_index)`, the entry's position in the filing's own list; joins to `lobbying_filings` on `filing_uuid`.

**Coverage.** Sampled from the filings held in `lobbying_filings`. One row per affiliated organization a filing discloses. Most filings disclose none and have no rows here. *(measured 2026-10-31)*

- **Parquet file:** `lobbying_affiliated_organizations.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filing_uuid` | `VARCHAR` | The filing; joins to `lobbying_filings.filing_uuid`. |
| `affiliated_organization_index` | `BIGINT` | The organization's position in the filing's `affiliated_organizations` list, from `0`. Completes the key. |
| `name` | `VARCHAR` | Affiliated organization name as filed. |
| `url` | `VARCHAR` | The organization's web address as filed (its own site, not an LDA link); null when none. |
| `address_1` | `VARCHAR` | First address line as filed; null when none. |
| `address_2` | `VARCHAR` | Second address line; null when none. |
| `address_3` | `VARCHAR` | Third address line; rarely set. |
| `address_4` | `VARCHAR` | Fourth address line; rarely set. |
| `city` | `VARCHAR` | City as filed; null when none. |
| `state` | `VARCHAR` | State code as filed (e.g. `CO`); null when none. |
| `state_display` | `VARCHAR` | LDA's display name for `state`. |
| `zip` | `VARCHAR` | ZIP or postal code as filed; null when none. |
| `country` | `VARCHAR` | Country code as filed (e.g. `US`). |
| `country_display` | `VARCHAR` | LDA's display name for `country`. |
| `ppb_city` | `VARCHAR` | City of the organization's principal place of business; null when none. |
| `ppb_state` | `VARCHAR` | State code of the principal place of business; null when none. |
| `ppb_state_display` | `VARCHAR` | LDA's display name for `ppb_state`. |
| `ppb_country` | `VARCHAR` | Country code of the principal place of business. |
